filterNotes: Dropped: all 30 Semgrep results (INFO/gas/best-practice only -> discarded per Informational rule), Slither timestamp (9, informational), missing-zero-check (3), too-many-digits/OZ-lib (1), Aderyn centralization-risk (15, by-design owner trust per known issues), push-zero-opcode (2), unspecific-solidity-pragma (2), state-no-address-check (5, mostly QA / matches by-design address(0)=disable semantics), uninitialized-local-variable (1, loop counter false positive).

findings.description: External call nftMinter.mint(dispatcherIndex, recipient) is made inside an unbounded for-loop bounded only by the caller-supplied `count` (line 207-209). N external calls scale linearly with attacker-controlled `count`; no upper bound on `count` means a large value can hit the block gas limit (DoS) or, combined with the count>=nudgeSize nudge gate, was the surface of the live batchMint exploit where an attacker 'could supply too many params'. Semgrep also flags the loop body (unnecessary-checked-arithmetic-in-loop) at line 207.

Unchecked return value of nftMinter.mint(dispatcherIndex, recipient) inside the batch loop. The return value of the trusted minter is ignored; if mint() can return a success/failure flag instead of reverting, a failed mint inside the batch is not detected. Slither reports the same site as unused-return (SLITHER-002).

BatchNFTMinter.batchMint ignores the return value of nftMinter.mint(dispatcherIndex, recipient) (line 208). Same root site as ADERYN-001 (unchecked-return). Relevant to the batchMint loop the live exploit targeted.

Reentrancy: NudgePaid event (line 223) emitted after the external nftMinter.mint() calls and after the nudge safeTransfer. batchMint has NO nonReentrant guard and only whenNotPaused; the trusted minter and nudge-token transfer are external calls. Event-only ordering, but worth noting batchMint lacks a reentrancy guard while NFTStaker user functions have one.

_recomputeSchedule ignores part of the tuple returned by nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) at line 386, destructuring only (price, growthBasisPoints). Likely intentional (only price/growthBasisPoints are needed for S = totalStaked*latestPrice) but flagged for review.

Reentrancy-no-eth: in unstake (458-477), state variables committedDebt/rewardBudget/totalStaked/users.rewardDebt are written after the external call chain _syncBudget() -> dispatcherHook.pull() (line 306) via _safePay. committedDebt/rewardBudget/totalStaked are reachable cross-function. Mitigated: unstake carries nonReentrant; dispatcherHook is a trusted owner-set contract. Aderyn corroborates with reentrancy-state-change (HIGH) at the stake path (line 445).

Reentrancy-no-eth: in claim (479-488), committedDebt/rewardBudget written after _syncBudget() -> dispatcherHook.pull() external call (line 306). Mitigated by nonReentrant and the trusted owner-set dispatcher hook. Same family as SLITHER-005/007.

Reentrancy: state change after external call in stake. user.amount/totalStaked/rewardDebt (lines 446-448) written after _syncBudget() -> dispatcherHook.pull() and stakedToken.safeTransferFrom. Mitigated by nonReentrant guard and trusted owner-set dispatcher hook / ERC1155 staked token. Same family as the Slither reentrancy-no-eth cluster (SLITHER-005/006 and _syncBudget line 299).
